what: Independent spot-check of the two automated coders (spec acceptance 2 & 10). Performed by Claude (Fable 5), 2026-07-31 -- a DIFFERENT model from the coder (gpt-4o-mini) and the discovery checker (deepseek-v4-pro), judging from the primary sources (action texts / transcripts / scenario files). Residual caveat: an LLM auditor cannot rule out blind spots correlated across LLMs; a human skim of the disagreement rows below closes that gap.

layer4_qual_coding.corrected_estimate: same_action codes: 5/9 hold. different_action codes: 10/12 hold (the 2 misses are number-vs-text contradictions, best read as same_action_different_label). Extrapolating the 2/12 rate over the 198 different_action codes: roughly 35-40 of 207 items are same_action_different_label (~18%), vs the coded 4.3%. different_action remains clearly dominant (~80%), so the idealized-self-model conclusion stands; cite '~80/20 (audited)' not '95.7%'.
layer4_qual_coding.new_phenomenon: number-vs-text contradiction: in 2/21 audited cells the other-framing's severity (4-5) contradicts its own honest action description -- cynical response-style noise, mirror of the self side.

discovery_flags.conclusion: 'discovered' flags: reliable. 'not discovered' flags: >=3/13 audited demonstrably wrong, several inconclusive -- error rate 25%+ on that side. Confirms D35 (filter is sensitivity-only); the sensitivity variant should be read as a noisy robustness check, nothing more.
